in_sanskrit.name: शीथाराम
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One who flows in cold conditions like Lord Rama

in_marathi.name: Seetharam
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of Loyalty
in_marathi.long_meaning: Seetharam हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Seetha Rama refers to Lord Rama, the seventh avatar of the Hindu god Vishnu, who is known for his loyalty, courage, and strength.

in_bengali.name: Seetharam
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ God of Loyalty
in_bengali.long_meaning: Seetharam একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Seetha Rama refers to Lord Rama, the seventh avatar of the Hindu god Vishnu, who is known for his loyalty, courage, and strength.
